name: Flipt
summary: Flipt is an open source feature flag tool that you run yourself, with unlimited flags in the free edition. Flipt Pro costs $200 a month for up to 10 instances with a 14-day trial. Enterprise is quoted and bills annually by invoice.

facts.text: Segments group entities by constraints, and rules tie those segments to flag variants.
Rollouts use distributions that split variants by percentage, and threshold rollouts that return true for a given percentage of entities.
Pro includes email support with a 24 hour response, and Open Source has community support only.
The pricing page offers a 20% saving on annual Pro billing but does not list the annual price.
The client integration page lists JavaScript, React, Python, Go, Java, Ruby, Dart, C#, Swift and Android SDKs.

plans.name: Open Source
plans.notes: Self-hosted, unlimited feature flags, community support

plans.name: Flipt Pro
plans.notes: Up to 10 instances, 14-day trial. The page shows $ without naming a currency

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Unlimited instances, annual contract with invoicing or purchase order billing
